expectations.text: The review flags the clickable div for search (not keyboard accessible, no role or name) and the icon-only delete button without an accessible name
expectations.evidence: Item 2 says the search control is a `<div>` with `onClick` that keyboard users can't reach and that "has no name", and item 5 says "the delete button has no accessible name" because its only content is an SVG.

expectations.text: The review flags blocked paste on the input and the destructive delete action without confirmation
expectations.evidence: Item 7 says "paste is blocked in the filter box" by `onPaste={(e) => e.preventDefault()}`, and the closing note says "a single click on delete fires `onDelete` right away, with no confirmation or undo."

expectations.text: The review flags the fixed toolbar using 100vh (dvh) and/or missing safe-area handling
expectations.evidence: Item 1 flags line 3 because it is "`position: fixed` with `height: '100vh'`", so it covers the whole screen. However, it says nothing about dvh or safe-area insets, so it only meets the "fixed toolbar using 100vh" part of the expectation.
